notes.title: Patch 1.11 - Just a fix or two.
notes.notes:
- The new side art has been redrawn to 1920x1080 properly (Alex did a good job touching up those lines)
- You can no longer select window resolutions higher than your native monitor resolution
* Which means we also added few new resolutions for those with fancier displays.

notes.title: Patch 1.1 - Improved Character Art!
notes.notes:
We heard you, you asked for better panel art and thanks to a new member who joined our team, it was made possible! (She's in the credits by the way)

- New Character Art (old one has been moved way back in order)
- Added brightness slider for Side art!
- Fixed Bullet Priorities (so they don't blend in each other anymore)
- Fixed alternate bullet colors having less frames than the originals

Store page's screenshots have been updated, a new trailer will be made soon.
